title: Food Delivery: ThaliDash
description: ThaliDash is a fictional Indian food-delivery platform operating in 10 cities with 600 partner restaurants and 900 delivery partners. Two years of deliveries, ratings and promo redemptions capture lunch and dinner peaks, IPL-season surges and monsoon disruption. Use it to study delivery time, SLA breaches, customer ratings, partner performance and promo ROI.

columns.name: onboarded_date
columns.description: Date the restaurant joined the platform

tables.name: delivery_partners
tables.description: Delivery riders (a few duplicate rows are deliberate).

tables.name: deliveries
tables.description: One row per order/delivery (~0.8% exact duplicate rows are deliberate).

columns.name: actual_minutes
columns.description: Actual minutes from order to delivery (NULL if cancelled)

columns.name: delay_minutes
columns.description: actual_minutes minus promised_minutes (NULL if cancelled; negative = early)

columns.name: order_value
columns.description: Food order value in INR (8 rows are 100x outliers)

columns.name: payment_mode
columns.description: UPI, Card, Cash on Delivery or Wallet

columns.name: weather
columns.description: Clear, Cloudy, Rain or Heavy Rain at delivery

tables.name: ratings
tables.description: Customer ratings for ~60-70% of delivered orders.

columns.name: is_new_user
columns.description: 1 if redemption by a first-time user

qualityIssues: deliveries: ~0.8% of rows (about 120) are exact duplicates by delivery_id, so delivery_id has no PRIMARY KEY constraint.
deliveries.actual_minutes, delay_minutes, delivered_time and cancel_reason are NULL by design for cancelled orders (~5-6% of rows).
deliveries.order_value: 8 rows are 100x outliers (e.g. 41,200 instead of 412).
restaurants.city ~8% and delivery_partners.city ~6% (and deliveries.city ~3%) have inconsistent casing or whitespace; restaurants.city ~2% NULL; delivery_partners.phone ~5% NULL.
promo_usage.promo_code: ~4% of values have inconsistent casing/whitespace.
CSV only - deliveries.order_time: ~15% of rows are DD-MM-YYYY HH:MM:SS instead of ISO.
CSV only - deliveries.order_value: ~15% of rows are text with rupee symbol and Indian grouping (e.g. '₹1,250').
CSV only - ratings.rated_at: ~25% of rows in DD-MM-YYYY format.
CSV only - promo_usage.discount_amount: ~20% of rows are text like '₹75.00'.

signals: [Instructor note] Delivery delay drives ratings: delivery_rating falls ~0.075 per minute of delay; late (delay > 10 min) orders average roughly 1-1.5 points lower than on-time orders; unhappy customers are also more likely to rate.
[Instructor note] Heavy Rain and Rain days (Mumbai/Kolkata/Pune Jun-Sep, Chennai Oct-Dec) add 6-13 minutes and raise cancellation rates (~3.5% base up to ~8%).
[Instructor note] Lunch (12-13h) and dinner (20-21h) peaks have longer waits; weekends are ~25% busier; order volume rises ~1.3x during IPL months (Mar 22-May 26 2024, Mar 31-May 28 2023).
[Instructor note] Partners in their first ~60 days are ~5 minutes slower; a skill factor per partner creates a spread in partner performance.

[Instructor note] FLAT75 is applied heavily to low-value orders (discount is a large share of order value), making it the worst-ROI promo; WELCOME50 drives new-user orders; IPLFEAST and MONSOON20 only appear in their seasons.
[Instructor note] Restaurant food quality varies independently of delivery speed (food_rating vs delivery_rating can be separated by analysts).
[Instructor note] 8 outlier order_values (100x) distort average order value.
